para: In late 2024 Google retired the Takeout "Location History" download and moved Timeline data on-device. The current export is a single Timeline.json file with a top-level "semanticSegments" array, a different structure from the older Takeout download. The "googletimeline" format reads this newer file.
If instead you have an older Takeout download archived (a ZIP of monthly JSON files, or per-year folders), use the googletakeout format.

There is no official documentation from Google for this format. A volunteer is maintaining a schema at
locationhistoryformat.com .

To export Timeline.json from an Android device:
Open the device Settings app
Go to Location > Location services > Timeline
Choose Export Timeline data and save the resulting Timeline.json file

example.title: Convert a Timeline export to GPX
Keep only the recorded tracks, dropping the visit waypoints

para.userinput: gpsbabel -i googletimeline -f Timeline.json -x nuketypes,waypoints -o gpx -F tracks.gpx
